paper: A Baseline for Detecting Misclassified and Out-of-Distribution Examples in Neural Networks
core_idea: Uses the maximum softmax probability as a confidence score; low MSP indicates OOD.

paper: Enhancing the Reliability of Out-of-Distribution Image Detection in Neural Networks
core_idea: Applies temperature scaling and small input perturbations to sharpen softmax separation between ID and OOD.

paper: Energy-based Out-of-distribution Detection
core_idea: Uses an energy score derived from model logits instead of softmax confidence to distinguish ID from OOD.

paper: ReAct: Out-of-distribution Detection With Rectified Activations
core_idea: Clips extreme activations at a chosen percentile before computing OOD scores such as MSP or energy.

paper: DICE: Leveraging Sparsification for Out-of-Distribution Detection
core_idea: Sparsifies network weights by importance to emphasise discriminative directions for OOD scoring.

paper: Extremely Simple Activation Shaping for Out-of-Distribution Detection
core_idea: Keeps only the highest-magnitude activations at a late layer and rescales them before computing OOD scores.

paper: Scaling for Training Time and Post-hoc Out-of-distribution Detection Enhancement
core_idea: Introduces scaling strategies at training and post-hoc stages to make OOD scores more separable.

paper: On the Importance of Gradients for Detecting Distributional Shifts in the Wild
core_idea: Uses the L1 norm of gradients backpropagated from the KL divergence between softmax output and uniform; gradient magnitude is higher for ID than OOD.

paper: A Simple Unified Framework for Detecting Out-of-Distribution Samples and Adversarial Attacks
core_idea: Fits class-conditional Gaussians with tied covariance in feature space and uses Mahalanobis distance as the OOD score.

paper: Probabilistic Modeling of Deep Features for Out-of-Distribution and Adversarial Detection
core_idea: Models the ID feature manifold (e.g. via PCA) and uses feature reconstruction error / likelihood as the OOD score. Identified by the core paper as the most promising direction for TS-OOD.

paper: Deep Anomaly Detection with Outlier Exposure
core_idea: Trains classifiers with an auxiliary outlier dataset, forcing near-uniform predictions on outliers.

paper: Diversified Outlier Exposure for Out-of-Distribution Detection via Informative Extrapolation
core_idea: Augments OE by synthesising diverse, informative outliers via multi-step optimisation, improving extrapolation beyond provided outliers.

paper: How Does Diversification Help Out-of-Distribution Detection? A Provable Framework
core_idea: Provides a provable framework for OOD detection with diversification, connecting auxiliary outliers and decision boundaries.

paper: Out-of-distribution Detection in Time-series Domain: A Novel Seasonal Ratio Scoring Approach
core_idea: Compares observed values to seasonality-aware expectations using ratio-based deviation scores via STL decomposition and a conditional VAE.

paper: CODiT: Conformal Out-of-Distribution Detection in Time-series Data for Cyber-Physical Systems
core_idea: Uses a conformal prediction framework with a temporal non-conformity measure to detect when windows fall outside the ID, with false-detection guarantees.

paper: TS-OOD: Evaluating Time-Series Out-of-Distribution Detection and Prospective Directions for Progress
core_idea: Core reference paper. Adapts classical deep OOD scores (DFM, MDS, MSP, EBO, ReAct) to TS backbones and evaluates them under a same-dataset semantic-shift protocol.

paper: DiffAD: Imputation-based Time Series Anomaly Detection with Conditional Weight-Incremental Diffusion
core_idea: Uses diffusion models to reconstruct normal time-series behaviour; large reconstruction error is treated as anomaly/OOD.

paper: Diversify: A General Framework for Time Series Out-of-distribution Detection and Generalization
core_idea: Learns diverse yet invariant predictors across latent environments via adversarial training and uses disagreement to detect OOD series.

paper: InvAD: Invertible Neural Networks for Out-of-Distribution Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
core_idea: Uses an invertible neural network with dual branches to separate information about seen anomalies from unseen OOD anomalies.

paper: M2N2: Memory-based Test-time Adaptation for Multivariate Time-series Anomaly Detection
core_idea: Adapts an unsupervised TS anomaly detector on-the-fly to new normal regimes using regularised test-time optimisation and memory.

paper: DiMMAD: Distance-Metric Ensembles for Detecting Unknown-Unknown Transient Events as OOD Anomalies
core_idea: Ensembles multiple distance metrics in feature space to detect unknown-unknown transient events as OOD anomalies.

paper: DEEDEE: Detecting OOD Environment Dynamics from Trajectory Statistics
core_idea: Uses two simple trajectory statistics to detect when environment dynamics become OOD relative to training.

paper: Time-Division and Variable-Density Multiscale Concept Drift Detection for Time Series
core_idea: Uses time-division and variable-density measures at multiple scales to detect concept drift in time series.

paper: CatSight: Common Spatial Pattern Analysis for Distributional Change Detection in Multivariate Sensor Data
core_idea: Applies common spatial pattern (CSP) analysis to multivariate sensor data to detect distributional changes.

paper: Combining Autoencoder Reconstruction, ADWIN Change Detection and LSTM Prediction for Evolving Multivariate Time Series
core_idea: Combines autoencoder reconstruction errors, ADWIN change detection and LSTM prediction to handle evolving patterns in ordered streams.

paper: DriftLens: Unsupervised Concept Drift Detection in Deep Learning Embeddings
core_idea: Detects drift by tracking distributional changes in latent representations produced by deep models.

paper: incDFM: Incremental Deep Feature Modeling for Continual Novelty Detection
core_idea: Models deep feature distributions incrementally and detects novel/OOD samples via reconstruction error while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

paper: ORSA: Adaptive Online Learning for Time-Series Forecasting under Distribution Shift
core_idea: Shift-triggered updating via consecutive loss monitoring plus invariant-variant parameter adaptation with a memory buffer.

paper: Precursor-of-Anomaly Detection for Irregular Time Series
core_idea: Learns to detect precursors indicating a series will soon enter an anomalous regime using neural CDEs and multi-task learning.

paper: Out-of-distribution Representation Learning for Time Series Classification (DIVERSIFY)
core_idea: Initial version of the DIVERSIFY framework, maximising diversity while enforcing invariance across TS environments.

paper: SIGLLM: Large Language Models for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
core_idea: Detects anomalies/OOD by prompting LLMs for forecasting or sequence reasoning and measuring deviations from expected behaviour.

paper: LLMAD: Time-Series Anomaly Detection via LLM Reasoning
core_idea: Applies LLM reasoning over sequential representations to score anomalous or novel (OOD-like) time-series segments.

paper: LogPrompt: Prompt-based Log Analysis for Anomaly and OOD Event Detection
core_idea: Uses structured prompt templates for logs; semantic or likelihood inconsistencies indicate anomalies or OOD events.

paper: OpenOOD v1.5: Enhanced Benchmark for Out-of-Distribution Detection
core_idea: Unified benchmark and reference implementation for dozens of OOD detection methods.

paper: Alibi-Detect: Algorithms for Outlier, Adversarial and Drift Detection
core_idea: Python library implementing a wide range of detectors for outliers and drift, including time-series methods.

paper: River: Machine Learning for Streaming Data in Python
core_idea: Online learning library with built-in drift detectors (ADWIN, DDM, EDDM, KSWIN) and anomaly detectors.

paper: Concept Drift Detection for Streaming Data via Linear Four Rates
core_idea: Monitors four performance rates (TPR, TNR, PPV, NPV) over time to detect distributional changes affecting classifier performance.

paper: FEDD: Feature Extraction for Explicit Concept Drift Detection in Time Series
core_idea: Extracts explicit time-series features online and monitors them to detect drift rather than only tracking prediction error.

paper: STUDD: A Student-Teacher Approach for Unsupervised Concept Drift Detection
core_idea: A student learns from a teacher's predictions; divergence between them signals concept drift without labels.

paper: Interpretable Indicator Monitoring for Unsupervised Drift Detection in Data Streams
core_idea: Monitors interpretable indicators over time to detect drift without labels and with human-understandable explanations.

paper: Autoencoder-based Anomaly Detection with Incremental Learning and Drift Detection (strAEm++DD)
core_idea: An autoencoder-based incremental learner augmented with drift detection to maintain performance under evolving distributions.

paper: Online Sequential Extreme Learning Machine for Concept Drift Detection in Streaming Time Series
core_idea: Uses an online sequential extreme learning machine and monitors prediction behaviour to detect concept drift.

paper: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
core_idea: Adjusts conformal prediction intervals online to maintain long-run coverage despite unknown distribution shifts.

paper: Adaptive Conformal Predictions for Time Series
core_idea: Adapts ACI for time series with dependency, tuning learning rates for efficient intervals under shift.

paper: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
core_idea: Bayesian posterior over run-length identifies regime shifts online.

paper: Optimal Detection of Changepoints with a Linear Computational Cost (PELT)
core_idea: Pruned exact linear-time changepoint detection for offline segmentation.

paper: Continuous Inspection Schemes (CUSUM)
core_idea: Sequential test for mean shifts.

paper: Selective Review of Offline Change Point Detection Methods (ruptures)
core_idea: Unified changepoint detection algorithms (PELT, BinSeg, Window-based, Kernel).

paper: Random Forests for Change Point Detection (ChangeForest)
core_idea: Random-forest proximity metrics detect structural shifts in high-dimensional time series.

paper: Optimal Transport for Change-Point Detection in Time-Series Distributions
core_idea: Detects change points via transport-distance trajectories between empirical distributions.

paper: TranAD: Deep Transformer Networks for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
core_idea: Transformer encoder-decoder with adversarial self-conditioning; reconstruction deviation scores anomalies.

paper: DROCC: Deep Robust One-Class Classification
core_idea: One-class classification that assumes ID data lies on a low-dimensional manifold and generates adversarial negatives.
